programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: To the north-west of Wales lies Anglesey, a beautiful corner of the United Kingdom. Only 400m of water separates Anglesey from the mainland, although it feels completely secluded. The 200km coastline is a designated Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty and an important habitat for flora and fauna.

programme.title: Exotic Destinations 101
programme.desc: Exotic Destinations 101 is a docuseries that explores hidden pieces of paradise around the globe. Each episode will feature stunning landscapes of a particular continent, diving into what Asia, Africa, America, Oceania and Europe have to offer, perfect.

programme.title: Rustic Adventures: Argentina
programme.sub-title: My Eyes Are Wide Open Now
programme.desc: A hybrid food, travel and adventure show, Season 1 of Rustic Adventures followed two young, hot chefs who fulfilled their lifelong dream of building their own successful restaurants – from scratch – as they decide to take a much needed break and seek out inspiration for new endeavors while on a rustic food tour across Italy. Following Season 1’s adventures in Italy, the rustic adventures continue for young chef/owners Rob Rossi and Craig Harding as they head for the towering mountain ranges and rugged countryside of Argentina. From the Pampas to the peaks of the Andes they’ll find endless inspiration in this South American hotspot.

programme.title: Todo Bien
programme.sub-title: All Good Things Come to an End
programme.desc: Baja holds an almost mystical reputation in the overland community. In this series MAK and Owen traverse the full length of the Baja peninsula and explore the landscapes, wildlife and culture. They also sprinkle in tips for traveling in Baja to help anyone curious about travel south of the border.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: No habla Espanol? No problem. A mecca for hard-core scuba divers and laid-back beach types for years, this tiny Central American country on the Caribbean coast has more to offer than at first glance, including ancient ruins, a melting pot of cultures and a wealth of natural splendor. And oh yeah, they speak English.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: KY Boyle County: Small Town, Big History
programme.desc: Danville Boyle County Kentucky Small Town. Big History Boats, Brass, and Brazilian Rum. Our Boyle County episode will highlight some Of central Kentucky’s little-known treasures including the historic town of Danville and the Dix River which forms Herrington Lake, home to Kentucky’s first reservoir that powers not only the surrounding areas through hydroelectricity, but ignites the hearts of boaters, kayakers, and jet ski enthusiasts. Along the way we’ll hear and see the spectacle that is the Great American Brass Band Festival; visit the Blue Rook Distillery and sample some regional cuisine and a “smoked” Old-Fashioned at Copper and Oak.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Shepherdsville, KY Bullitt County: Wine, Whiskey & Wild Part 2
programme.desc: The second part of our Bullitt County visit will begin at the longest g-cart track in the US followed by a visit to the MillaNova and Wight Meyer wineries. Carrie will paddle the Salt River with a special guest who shares some little known history about the river which powered several distilleries and yes, quite a bit of salt. Our hosts will finish up at the famous James B Beam Distillery in Clermont Kentucky where a new restaurant, the Kitchen Table serves up some local fare with a splash of bourbon. This is the second of a two-part special featuring Shepherdsville and Bullitt County Kentucky.
